newsitem.title: FINLAND: Kemira sees 1997 earnings almost at 1996 level.
newsitem.headline: Kemira sees 1997 earnings almost at 1996 level.

text.p: Finnish chemicals and fertiliser group Kemira Oy said in a statement on Tuesday it expected first tertial earnings to be below the year-ago period but the full year result would be almost at last year's level.
"Profitability of Kemira Group for the current year is expected to remain at almost last year's record level," it quoted CEO Heimo Karinen as having told the Annual General Meeting on Tuesday.
"Mainly because of Kemira Agro, the result is expected to develop in a different manner, with the first four months at a weaker level than a year earlier," it said.
